competitor.name: Aon
competitor.description: Leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement, and health solutions.

items.title: Aon Accelerates NFP Integration Across Middle-Market P&C Accounts
items.summary: Aon completed Phase II integration of NFP's retail brokerage networks, deploying proprietary Risk Analyzer software to 12,000 mid-sized accounts.

items.title: Aon Unveils Climate Risk Financial Impact Assessment Platform
items.summary: Launched Climate Analytics Studio offering scenario simulations for hurricane surge and wildfire risk exposure to commercial property policyholders.

items.title: Aon Leadership Reorganizes Commercial Risk Solutions Under Single P&L
items.summary: Unified enterprise risk and mid-market commercial brokerage under Eric Andersen to streamline carrier negotiations and capacity agreements.

items.title: Aon P&C Pricing Survey Highlights D&O Softening and Excess Liability Pressure
items.summary: Published quarterly pricing insights reporting 8.5% decreases in public D&O rates, offset by 11% spikes in commercial auto and umbrella liability.

items.title: Aon Acquires Specialized Logistics & Cargo Brokerage Navis Marine
items.summary: Expanded maritime supply chain risk practice with acquisition of Gulf Coast specialty marine intermediary Navis Marine.

battlecard_template.headline: Enterprise Analytics Push Targeting High-Value Mid-Market Accounts
battlecard_template.subtext: Following the NFP transaction, Aon is pairing sophisticated predictive modeling tools with regional producers to win mid-market commercial accounts.

wins.title: Dedicated Senior Practitioner Attention
wins.text: Pitch against Aon's junior account executive rotation by promising sustained direct access to senior brokerage principals.

wins.title: Practical Actionable Risk Engineering
wins.text: Provide pragmatic, hands-on safety loss control rather than overwhelming client CFOs with dense, theoretical statistical modeling software.

wins.title: Independent Regional Carrier Access
wins.text: Emphasize our access to regional mutuals and specialty carriers that Aon's national placement desk frequently overlooks.

moves.summary: Completed Phase II rollout of NFP network integration with proprietary Risk Analyzer software.
Unveiled Climate Analytics Studio to simulate physical climate risk and hurricane exposures.
Unified Commercial Risk Solutions under executive director Eric Andersen.
